comments.author: Zibel
comments.body: Apparently the quest won't pop=up without knowing the language or using a translation note. I spend more than 100 qmp and the quest dind't show. It show only after I put on me a translation note. This is meant to save some qmp for you guys.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Although it turned up for my friends and I without the language or notes, it does seem like some/most/all quests will appear more frequently if you use that strategy to match the listed skills. Sorry to hear you had such problems in getting it; thanks for taking time to help out your fellow players. Cheers.
